episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Maxine is ready to start a new life in Palm Beach. While trying to join an elite club, she discovers several secrets—while hiding her own.

episodes.title: Maxine Saves a Cat
episodes.summary: To gain membership sponsors, Maxine must make an impressive splash at a charity auction—but bad checks and a suspicious bartender hound her.

episodes.title: Maxine's Like a Dellacorte
episodes.summary: When Maxine's auction antics land her in the Shiny Sheet, the ladies of Palm Beach become interested in knowing more about her.

episodes.title: Maxine Rolls the Dice
episodes.summary: With Norma's estate going to charity, Maxine's last shot at the D'ellacorte fortune is a conservatorship that puts her at legal odds with Robert.

episodes.title: Maxine Shakes the Tree
episodes.summary: Maxine tries to unearth information that could upend her marriage. Linda and the Women's Circle grapple with threats to Palm Beach social order.

episodes.title: Maxine Takes a Step
episodes.summary: With both the Beach Ball and a real estate deal set to take off, Maxine and Douglas need to secure the favor of a visiting prince.

episodes.title: Maxine Bags a Prince
episodes.summary: Douglas faces a looming threat. Robert navigates his increasingly serious relationship with the prince. Linda and Evelyn receive shocking news.

episodes.title: Maxine Saves the Whale
episodes.summary: A beached whale appears on the Beach Ball site, throwing the event into doubt with days to spare. Linda and Evelyn adjust to their new normals.

episodes.title: Maxine Makes a Splash
episodes.summary: Evelyn must hide at Eddie's place. Doug makes a pitch for the Dellacorte. Maxine and Robert make shocking discoveries.

episodes.title: Maxine Throws a Party
episodes.summary: Season finale. Tensions boil over at the Beach Ball.

episodes.title: Maxine Drinks Martinis Now
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the Beach Ball fiasco, Maxine navigates her new reality and contends with Douglas' betrayal.

episodes.title: Maxine Swerves a Swerve
episodes.summary: As Linda's case makes it to national television, Maxine botches her own plan and must help her friend before the (wo)manhunt begins.

episodes.title: Maxine Solves a Murder
episodes.summary: Maxine arranges a covert mission during the Dellacorte portrait ceremony. Evelyn grills the Club Ambassador, leading to an epiphany.

episodes.title: Maxine Unwrecks a Home
episodes.summary: The feds pursue Maxine, who further damages her reputation by attempting to compromise the investigation. Robert tries to hide Norma's secret.

episodes.title: Maxine Is Ready to Single Mingle
episodes.summary: Evelyn and Maxine must strike a deal with a powerful socialite to finance their plan.Maxine clicks with the charismatic Dr. Dusty Magic.

episodes.title: Maxine Finds Herself
episodes.summary: Virginia enlists Maxine and Douglas to help find the Russian mole. The arrival of a new family member complicates the matter.

episodes.title: Maxine Plays Dead
episodes.summary: Robert is torn between his best friend and his oldest friend. Dinah uncovers the source of her death threats.

episodes.title: Maxine Hits the Slopes
episodes.summary: Palm Beach society arrives in Switzerland with sights set on the Dellacorte generation-skipping trust.

episodes.title: Maxine Hears a Confession
episodes.summary: Amid a raging snowstorm in the Alps, Norma orchestrates plans to secure the fortune for herself and Robert. Maxine races to expose her.

episodes.title: Maxine Does Something Good
episodes.summary: Season finale. Maxine and Evelyn work to ensure the wedding isn't jeopardized—if Maxine's guilt doesn't get to her first.
